title: CNC3-Voices-eng
description:
[h1]CNC3-Voices-eng[/h1]
Command & Conquer 3 unit voice lines (English), for Command & Conquer Remastered Collection mods (Red Alert). One of the asset packs from [url=https://github.com/gibbo101/cnc-ra-tiberian-factions]Tiberian Factions[/url].

You do not need this pack to play Tiberian Factions: the mod already includes everything in it. It is here for other modders to use in their own mods.

[h2]Contents[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Sounds (Data/AUDIO)[/b] (35): C3MATA, C3MATB, C3MATC, C3MATD, C3MATE, C3MATF, C3MMOA, C3MMOB, C3MMOC, C3MMOD, C3MMOE, C3MMOF, C3MSEA, C3MSEB, C3MSEC, C3MSED, C3MSEE, C3MSEF, C3PATA, C3PATB, C3PATC, C3PATD, C3PATE, C3PATF, C3PMOA, C3PMOB, C3PMOC, C3PMOD, C3PMOE, C3PSEA, C3PSEB, C3PSEC, C3PSED, C3PSEE, C3PSEF
[/list]

[h2]Using it[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Copy the files under this pack's Data folder into your mod's Data folder, keeping the paths.
[*]Copy the entries you need from this pack's XML files into your mod's own XML files:
[list]
[*]Data/XML/TILESETS/CNC3_UNITS.XML into Data/XML/TILESETS/RA_UNITS.XML
[*]Data/XML/TILESETS/CNC3_STRUCTURES.XML into Data/XML/TILESETS/RA_STRUCTURES.XML
[*]Data/XML/TILESETS/CNC3_VFX.XML into Data/XML/TILESETS/RA_VFX.XML
[*]Data/XML/TILESETS/CNC3_TERRAIN_TEMPERATE.XML into Data/XML/TILESETS/RA_TERRAIN_TEMPERATE.XML
[*]Data/XML/TILESETS/CNC3_TERRAIN_SNOW.XML into Data/XML/TILESETS/RA_TERRAIN_SNOW.XML
[*]Data/XML/TILESETS/CNC3_TERRAIN_INTERIOR.XML into Data/XML/TILESETS/RA_TERRAIN_INTERIOR.XML
[*]Data/XML/OBJECTS/UNITS/CNC3BUILDABLES.XML into Data/XML/OBJECTS/UNITS/RABUILDABLES.XML
[*]Data/XML/AUDIO/SFXEVENTSNONLOCALIZED_CNC3.XML into Data/XML/AUDIO/SFXEVENTSNONLOCALIZED.XML
[*]Data/XML/AUDIO/SFXEVENTSLOCALIZED_CNC3.XML into Data/XML/AUDIO/SFXEVENTSLOCALIZED.XML
[/list]The launcher only reads the mod's own files, so enabling the pack by itself changes nothing in game.
[/olist]
The pack's README on [url=https://github.com/gibbo101/cnc-ra-tiberian-factions/tree/main/asset-packs/CNC3-Voices-eng]GitHub[/url] has the same notes.

[h2]Credits[/h2]
Original Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars assets: Electronic Arts. Prepared for Remastered by gibbo101 for Tiberian Factions.
